hypothesis_mapping.quotient_membership: Matching homomorphic images gives the normalized element in the kernel.
hypothesis_mapping.omission_and_independence: Original family is independent; the extra index is outside B; every correction word belongs to closure(s image B). These hypotheses put each allowed expression inside the original omission subgroup.
hypothesis_mapping.generation: With corrections in the base, adding all normalized elements generates exactly the old subgroup; no independence assumption is required.
hypothesis_mapping.base_conjugates: Every conjugating element belongs to the omission subgroup because it lies in the base.
hypothesis_mapping.all_conjugates: N is normal, internally commutative, contains all normalized elements and factors G as N*base. Conjugation reduces to the base action. These are actual hypotheses, not conclusions assumed under new names.
hypothesis_mapping.written_instantiation: Take w_j=s_j for indices in the quotient-generating base and choose correction words for the other indices. Then every normalized base element is1; G=N*base follows from quotient generation.

formal_scope: Eight actual generic normalization, generation and conjugation-independence statements underlying Cameron-Cara normal-quotient inequality. The all-conjugates theorem explicitly assumes a normal internally abelian kernel and factorization G=N*base.
